entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6219380139469026432: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 72571: distance 101.523 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.07), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 101.523 +/- 7.107 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 10.8024 +/- 0.4036 mas (same row, RUWE 7.63), 26.8 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -238.580, -62.451 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 6219380139469026432 (quality B), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 34.657 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 72571: radius 34.657 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 310.321 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.093) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4118 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 72571: effective temperature 4118 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.043).
